title: Array index used as a key
message: Your users can see & submit the wrong data when this list reorders or filters, so use a stable id like `key={item.id}`, not the array index "i".
help: Use a stable id from the item, like `key={item.id}` or `key={item.slug}`. Index keys break when the list reorders or filters.

title: Array lookup inside a loop
message: This scales poorly because `array.includes()` inside a loop scans the whole list every time. Use a Set for constant-time lookups.
help: Use a `Set` or `Map` when you check for the same items over and over. `Array.includes`/`find` scans the whole list each time

title: Click handler missing keyboard handler
message: Keyboard users can't trigger this click handler because there's no keyboard one, so add `onKeyUp`, `onKeyDown`, or `onKeyPress`.
help: Pair `onClick` with a key handler so keyboard users can trigger it.

title: Interaction on static element
message: Screen reader users can't tell this click handler is interactive because it has no `role`, so add a `role` or use a button or link.
help: Give clickable static elements a `role`, or use a button or link.

title: Empty default prop breaks memo
message: This keeps redrawing children that compare props because default prop value [] makes a brand new array every render, so move it to a constant at the top of the file
help: Move it to the top of the file: `const EMPTY_ITEMS: Item[] = []`, then use that as the default value

title: Custom modal instead of dialog
message: Keyboard users can tab out of this `role="dialog"` modal because it has no built-in focus trapping, so use the native `<dialog>`, which gives you focus trapping, `Escape` to close, and the backdrop for free.
help: Replace the wrapper with `<dialog>` and open it with `dialog.showModal()`. For the trigger, prefer `<button commandfor="id" command="show-modal">` (Chrome 135+), or a `useRef` with `dialogRef.current?.showModal()`.

title: await inside a loop
message: This makes the for…of loop slow because each await runs one after another, so collect the independent calls & run them together with `await Promise.all(items.map(...))`
help: Collect the items, then use `await Promise.all(items.map(...))` so independent work runs at the same time

title: React function has high control-flow complexity
message: `FieldInput` has cyclomatic complexity 16, cognitive complexity 9, and maximum nesting depth 2, so its React logic is hard to understand and change. Extract independent branches into components or hooks.
help: Extract independent render branches and state logic into focused components or hooks until the control flow is easy to follow.

title: State initializer runs on every render
message: useState(map()) re-runs map() on every render & throws the result away.
help: Wrap expensive initial state in an arrow function so the initializer does not rerun and get thrown away on every render.
